verdict.rationale: Grafana documents several programmatic surfaces: a published OpenAPI spec, Observability as Code for defining dashboards, data sources and other configuration in code, and a terminal CLI for authentication and administrative tasks. Nothing in the evidence shows that these surfaces cover everything the UI can do, so only part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or documentation of API/UI parity, evidence that alerting, SLO, on-call and incident workflows are fully API-addressable, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
